_comment: 🧬️ The glTF 2.0 Any mutation catalog is an exact 120-row mirror of the direct semantic folders, derived aggregate variants, language-neutral descriptors, payload schemas, language surfaces, and json-rust differential vectors.

oracles.rationale:
🫥️ RECLASSIFIED, BY ITS OWN RATIONALE. This entry was registered `third-party-library` on the strength of the `json` crate, and its own text says why that does not hold: `json` is domain-BLIND, it knows nothing about glTF, so "every one of the registered kinds' actual semantics is REIMPLEMENTED FROM SCRATCH" in the sibling `🦀️component.rs`. The third-party component is a JSON tokenizer; the thing under test — what a glTF mutation should produce — is computed by 601 lines of this repository's own Rust. Both halves of the comparison then read the same specification, so a misreading of it produces two agreeing wrong answers. That is a `cross-semio-implementation`: a required SUPPLEMENT, never a substitute.

IT ALSO OVERCLAIMED ITS SCOPE BY A FACTOR OF SEVENTEEN. Its `apply` dispatch implements exactly SEVEN kinds — bind/unbind-node-child, bind/unbind-scene-root-node, change-material-alpha-mode, change-material-double-sided, create-scene — and returns `mutation kind {other} has no oracle implementation` for everything else. The manifest nevertheless named it against all 120 of this subset's mutations. 120 mutations were counted as externally oracled on the strength of an implementation that refuses 113 of them.

WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY DISCHARGE THESE. A domain-aware third-party glTF reader, which exists and is already vendored: `three` 0.182.0's `GLTFLoader` is registered and qualified for the sibling `s.stdio.semio@v1/✳️mesh` subset, where it reads real glTF geometry AND PBR material state. Pointing it at this subset is the work that would make these 120 honest; naming this entry was not.

comparisonProfiles.description: glTF 2.0 documents compared by the default scene, every scene's root node list, every node's child list and every material's alphaMode/doubleSided -- the entire normative surface the 7 registered mutation kinds touch. Geometry, accessors, buffers, images, samplers, textures, skins, animations, cameras and extensions are out of scope: no registered kind observes them, the same way semantic-mesh-v1 leaves precision and naming to writer freedom.
